## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Checklist

- [ ] I added changes made to CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] I have validated and corrected code quality comments.
- [ ] I selected the correct milestone.
- [ ] I selected myself as PR owner.
- [ ] For a published integration, I selected the associated release branch as the PR base and checked that the diff contains only the intended changes.
- [ ] For a published integration, I verified that the documented Point flows use the public API of the released SDK.
- [ ] I have validated the pull request name format ([SMARTI-XXXX] Jira ticket title).
- [ ] I tested my changes using the DemoApp.
